🎥🎬: Breeder

A family expecting to bring a newborn into their lives becomes trapped in a horrifying nightmare when a seemingly ordinary situation takes a disturbing turn. What should be a time of excitement and preparation quickly becomes a fight for survival.

As the danger escalates, the family is forced to confront a terrifying threat that blurs the line between human nature and something far more sinister. With fear closing in and nowhere feeling safe, they must uncover what is really happening before it’s too late.

What begins as an ordinary family story slowly transforms into a disturbing horror experience filled with tension, secrets, and survival.
